the-fool.title: The Fool
meaning:
Air

In spiritual matters, the Fool means idea, thought, spirituality, that which endeavours to transcend earth.

In material matters, it may, if badly dignified, mean folly, eccentricity, or even mania.

But the essential of this card is that it represents an original, subtle, sudden impulse or impact, coming from a completely strange quarter.

All such impulses are right, if rightly received; and the good or ill interpretation of the card depends entirely on the right attitude of the Querent.
the-fool.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of transcendent insight, where the force of Air harmonizes with the fiery spark of initiation. The Fool, empowered by Fire's passion and creativity, manifests as inspired genius and fearless exploration into new realms of thought and spirit. This is the purest expression of original impulse, guiding you to breakthrough revelations and transformative beginnings.
the-fool.illDignified: The force of Air, when weighed down by the stubbornness of Earth, becomes confused and erratic. The Fool's noble impulses may devolve into reckless folly, mental agitation, or fixed delusions that hinder growth. Beware the distortion of sudden ideas into obsessive or destructive patterns, as your spiritual quest risks becoming mired in confusion or mania.

the-hanged-man.title: The Hanged Man
meaning:
Water

Let not the waters whereon thou journeyest wet thee. And, being come to shore, plant thou the Vine and rejoice without shame.

Enforced sacrifice, punishment, loss, fatal or voluntary, suffering, defeat, failure, death.
the-hanged-man.wellDignified: You stand at a threshold of profound emotional insight, where the waters of sacrifice nourish the fertile earth of your spirit. In this harmonious union, enforced trials become transformative blessings, allowing you to cultivate wisdom and rejoice in enlightened surrender.
the-hanged-man.illDignified: The force of fire agitates the waters, turning sacrifice into needless torment and clarity into chaos. You risk being consumed by destructive passions that distort your suffering into punishment without purpose, leading to spiritual stagnation and despair.

the-sun.title: The Sun
meaning:
The Sun

Give forth thy light to all without doubt; the clouds and shadows are no matter for thee. Make Speech and Silence, Energy and Stillness, twin forms of thy play.

Glory, gain, riches, triumph, pleasure, frankness, truth, shame-lessness, arrogance, vanity, manifestation, recovery from sickness, but sometimes sudden death.
the-sun.wellDignified: You stand at the zenith of radiant clarity and joyous manifestation. The force of Air elevates your light, inspiring truth, intellectual illumination, and harmonious communication. Your presence dispels all shadows, empowering you to shine with integrity and creative brilliance.
the-sun.illDignified: The force of Water clouds your brilliance with emotional turbulence and confusion. Your radiant energy becomes obscured by fear, illusions, or excessive sensitivity, leading to arrogance that blinds or a vanity that isolates. Beware the shadows that distort your light, for they threaten to extinguish your true power.

ace-of-wands.title: Ace of Wands
meaning:
The Root of Fire

This card represents the essence of the element of Fire in its inception. It is a solar-phallic outburst of flame from which spring lightnings in every direction. These flames are Yods, arranged in the form of the Tree of Life.

It is the primordial Energy of the Divine manifesting in Matter, at so early a stage that it is not yet definitely formulated as Will.
ace-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the dawning of pure creative power, where the spark of divine will ignites with clarity and purpose. The force of Fire, harmonized by Air, elevates your energy into inspired action, illuminating new pathways and fostering visionary breakthroughs. This is the moment of purposeful initiation, where your intent burns brightly and manifests with confident mastery.
ace-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your primal energy is drowned in the waters of uncertainty and emotional turbulence. When Fire clashes with Water, your creative impulse becomes erratic and suppressed, flickering weakly amidst confusion and self-doubt. You face the challenge of regaining control over your will, lest your vital spark be extinguished by overwhelming feelings and inertia.

ace-of-cups.title: Ace of Cups
meaning:
The Root of Water

This card represents the element of Water in its most secret and original form. It is the feminine complement of the Ace of Wands, and is derived from the Yoni and the Moon exactly as that is from the Lingam and the Sun. The third in the Hierarchy. This accordingly represents the essential form of the Holy Grail. Upon the dark sea of Binah, the Great Mother, are Lotuses, two in one, which fill the cup with the Life-fluid, symbolically represented either as Water, as Blood, or as Wine, according to the selected purpose of the symbolism.

Above the Cup, descending upon it, is the Dove of the Holy Ghost, thus consecrating the element. At the base of the Cup is the Moon, for it is the virtue of this card to conceive and to produce the second form of its Nature.
ace-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound emotional and spiritual renewal. The force of Water harmonizes with Earth, grounding your intuitive insights into tangible manifestations of love, compassion, and healing. This sacred union elevates the Holy Grail's essence within you, allowing the purest life-fluid of creativity and receptivity to flow freely and nurture all aspects of your being.
ace-of-cups.illDignified: The force of Water clashes with Fire, and the sacred cup becomes turbulent and unstable. Your emotions may overflow with confusion, jealousy, or destructive passion, clouding the purity of your inner vision. Beware the corruption of the Holy Grail’s essence; what should be a source of life and renewal risks becoming a vessel of emotional chaos and spiritual disarray.

the-magus.title: The Magus
meaning:
Mercury

The True Self is the meaning of the True Will: know Thyself through Thy Way. Calculate well the Formula of Thy Way. Create freely; absorb joyously; divide intently; consolidate completely. Work thou, Omnipotent, Omniscient, Omni present, in and for Eternity.

Skill, wisdom, adroitness, elasticity, craft, cunning, deceit, theft. Sometimes occult wisdom or power, sometimes a quick impulse, a brain-wave. It may imply messages, business transactions, the interference of learning or intelligence with the matter in hand.
the-magus.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of mastery, where your intellect and skill harmonize with the elemental fire to manifest inspired creation. The Magus channels divine energy with clarity and purpose, transforming ideas into potent realities through will and wisdom.
the-magus.illDignified: The force of The Magus is undermined, twisting into cunning manipulation and deceit when constrained by the stubborn weight of earth. Your talents may be misused for selfish gain, leading to confusion, trickery, and the erosion of trust in your dealings.

the-priestess.title: The Priestess
meaning:
The Moon

Purity is to live only to the Highest; and the Highest is All; be thou as Artemis to Pan. Read thou in the Book of the Law, and break through the veil of the Virgin.

Pure, exalted and gracious influence enters the matter. Hence, change, alternation, increase and decrease, fluctuation. There is, however, a liability to be led away by enthusiasm; one may become 'moon-struck' unless careful balance is maintained.
the-priestess.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound inner knowing, where the lunar tides of emotion harmonize with the grounding strength of earth. The Priestess reveals your capacity for intuitive wisdom, manifesting insight that nurtures growth and stability. Embrace this sacred balance, for your purity of vision now shapes reality with gentle yet unwavering power.
the-priestess.illDignified: The force of fire threatens to scorch the delicate veil of your intuitive sanctuary, leaving you vulnerable to confusion and illusion. The Priestess, overwhelmed by discordant energies, may lead you into delusion or fanaticism, your clarity fractured by impulsive desires. Guard your mind against the chaos; only through measured reflection can you reclaim your true path.

the-empress.title: The Empress
meaning:
Venus

This is the Harmony of the Universe, that Love unites the Will to create with the Understanding of that Creation: understand thou thine own Will. Love and let love. Rejoice in every shape of love, and get thy rapture and thy nourishment thereof.

Love, beauty, happiness, pleasure, success, completion, good fortune, graciousness, elegance, luxury, idleness, dissipation debauchery, friendship, gentleness, delight.
the-empress.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of earthly abundance, where the nurturing force of Venus harmonizes effortlessly with the fluid currents of water. The Empress here manifests as a radiant source of fertility, creativity, and emotional fulfillment, guiding you to cultivate love and beauty that flow naturally and enrich both spirit and matter.
the-empress.illDignified: The force of Venus becomes fragmented and stifled when confronted with the sharp, restless winds of air. In this state, The Empress may embody superficial charm twisted into manipulation, indulgence devolving into excess, and love corrupted by detachment or cruelty. Beware the erosion of genuine connection under such discordant influence.

the-emperor.title: The Emperor
meaning:
Aries

Pour water on thyself thus shalt thou be a Fountain to the Universe. Find thou thyself in every Star. Achieve thou every possibility.

War, conquest, victory, strife, ambition, originality, over-weening confidence and megalomania, quarrelsomeness, energy, vigour, stubbornness, impracticability, rashness, ill- temper.
the-emperor.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of purposeful action, where the fiery Aries energy is harmoniously fanned by the breath of Air. The Emperor manifests as a wise and just leader, whose ambition is tempered by clarity and intellect, enabling you to conquer challenges with strategic brilliance and unwavering confidence.
the-emperor.illDignified: The force of the Emperor becomes turbulent when smothered by the waters of emotion, twisting his fiery will into rashness and destructive pride. You may find yourself overwhelmed by inner storms of doubt or anger, leading to stubborn obstinacy, quarrels, and a loss of constructive direction.

the-hierophant.title: The Hierophant
meaning:
Taurus

Offer thyself Virgin to the Knowledge and Con- versation of thine Holy Guardian Angel. All else is a snare. Be thou athlete with the eight limbs of Yoga: for without these thou are not disciplined for any fight.

Stubborn strength, toil, endurance, placidity, manifestation, explanation, teaching, goodness of heart, help from superiors, patience, organisation, peace.
the-hierophant.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of divine wisdom, where the force of Earth harmonizes with the fluidity of Water. The Hierophant, in this exalted state, embodies steadfast spiritual guidance and nurturing compassion, enabling you to manifest sacred teachings with patience and heartfelt understanding. Through this alignment, you become a living conduit of enduring truth and harmonious order.
the-hierophant.illDignified: The force of Earth clashes with the airy currents, causing the Hierophant's steadfastness to harden into rigidity and dogma. You risk becoming ensnared in inflexible doctrines and hollow formalism, where true wisdom is obscured by intellectual arrogance and disconnection from the heart. Beware, for this distortion breeds spiritual stagnation and fractured authority.

the-lovers.title: The Lovers
meaning:
Gemini

The Oracle of the Gods is the Child- Voice of Love in Thine own Soul; hear thou it. Heed not the Siren-Voice of Sense, or the Phantom-Voice of Reason: rest in Simplicity, and listen to the Silence.

Openness to inspiration, intuition, intelligence, second sight, childishness, frivolity, thoughtfulness divorced from practical consideration, indecision, self-contradiction, union in a shallow degree with others, instability, contradiction, triviality, the 'high-brow'.
the-lovers.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of enlightened union, where intellect and inspiration harmonize to reveal profound truths. The force of Air, tempered by Fire, ignites clarity and decisive love, fostering authentic connections rooted in higher understanding and spiritual insight.
the-lovers.illDignified: You face confusion and fragmentation as the airy ideals clash with the heavy, unyielding nature of Earth. The force of Air becomes trapped in rigid materialism, leading to indecision, superficial attachments, and a loss of true connection beneath the weight of doubt and practicality.

the-chariot.title: The Chariot
meaning:
Cancer

The Issue of the Vulture, Two-in-One, conveyed; this is the Chariot of Power. TRINC: the last oracle.

Triumph, victory, hope, memory, digestion, violence in maintaining traditional ideas, the 'die-hard', ruthlessness, lust of destruction, obedience, faithfulness, authority under authority.
the-chariot.wellDignified: You stand at the helm of disciplined strength, where the nurturing flow of earth grounds the watery energies of the Chariot. This union manifests as steadfast determination, harmonious control, and the wise channeling of emotional power into tangible success. The force of your will is both compassionate and unyielding, guiding you triumphantly along your destined path.
the-chariot.illDignified: The force of the Chariot becomes turbulent and unbalanced when confronted with the fiery element, igniting reckless impulsiveness and aggressive domination. Your drive may devolve into destructive obstinacy, where violence and lust for control override reason and faithfulness. Beware, for this corruption leads to the ruin of tradition and the loss of true authority.

adjustment.title: Adjustment
meaning:
Libra

Balance against each thought its exact opposite. For the Marriage of these is the Annihilation of Illusion.

Justice, or rather justesse, the act of adjustment, suspension of all action pending decision; in material matters, may refer to law suits or prosecutions. Socially, marriage or marriage agreements; politically, treaties.
adjustment.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of equitable judgment, where the breath of fire ignites clarity and swift resolution. The force of Adjustment harmonizes with the dynamic energy of fire, enabling you to enact profound change through balanced decisions and enlightened diplomacy. Here, the scales tip not toward mere fairness, but toward transformative justice that fosters growth and renewal.
adjustment.illDignified: The force of Adjustment is burdened and clouded when weighed down by the inert earth, causing the scales to falter and justice to become rigid or oppressive. You face distortion where balance turns to stubbornness, and the noble pursuit of truth is mired in material obsession or legalistic entrapment. Beware the paralysis of false equity, where illusion masquerades as fairness, imprisoning your will to act.

the-hermit.title: The Hermit
meaning:
Virgo

Wander alone; bearing the Light and thy Staff. And be the Light so bright that no man seeth thee. Be not moved by aught without or within: keep Silence in all ways.

Illumination from within, secret impulse from within; practical plans derived accordingly. Retirement from participation in current events.
the-hermit.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of inner wisdom, where your solitary journey illuminates not only your path but also those who seek your guidance. The force of Water harmonizes with your Earth element, deepening your intuitive insight and fostering profound emotional clarity. In this exalted state, your silence becomes a sacred vessel from which practical illumination flows, enabling you to manifest grounded plans with compassionate understanding.
the-hermit.illDignified: The force of Air disrupts your grounded solitude, scattering your focus and breeding restlessness within your once steady heart. You find yourself lost in endless mental chatter, your inner light dimmed by distractions and superficialities. This corrupted expression leaves you isolated not by choice but by confusion, your staff a fragile crutch against the relentless winds of doubt and indecision.

fortune.title: Fortune
meaning:
Jupiter

Follow thy Fortune, careless where it lead thee. The axle moveth not: attain thou that.

Change of fortune. (This generally means good fortune because the fact of consultation implies anxiety or discontent.)
fortune.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of expansive growth and cosmic opportunity. The force of Jupiter, harmonized with the airy currents of intellect and clarity, propels your fortune toward sublime abundance and visionary success. Embrace this golden moment where destiny and wisdom converge, ushering in transformative blessings beyond mere chance.
fortune.illDignified: Beware, for the fiery wheel of Fortune is mired by the watery tides of doubt and emotional turbulence. Your fate becomes a tempest of chaos, where misguided impulses and fluctuating moods distort the path of prosperity. Resist surrendering your will to these currents, lest good fortune slip through your grasp into the abyss of despair.

lust.title: Lust
meaning:
Leo

Mitigate Energy with Love; but let Love devour all things. Worship the name _______, foursquare, mystic, wonderful, and the name of His House 418.

Courage, strength, energy and action, une grande passion; resort to magick, the use of magical power.
lust.wellDignified: You stand at the blazing heart of divine passion, where the force of fire is fanned by the clarity of air. Your courage and strength manifest as inspired action, fueled by elevated purpose and spiritual will. Here, Lust becomes the sacred alchemy of love and power, a gateway to transformative magick and heroic deeds.
lust.illDignified: Beware, for the consuming fire of Lust is doused and fragmented by the overwhelming tides of water. Your fervor may turn to reckless desire or destructive obsession, weakening your will and scattering your energies. In this state, the sacred passion devolves into chaos, enslavement to base impulses, and loss of true spiritual strength.

death.title: Death
meaning:
Scorpio

The Universe is Change; every Change is the effect of an Act of Love; all Acts of Love contain Pure Joy. Die daily. Death is the apex of one curve of the snake Life: behold all Opposites as necessary complements, and rejoice.

Transformation, change, voluntary or involuntary, in either case logical development of existing conditions, yet perhaps sudden and unexpected. Apparent death or destruction, but such interpretation is illusion.
death.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound metamorphosis, where the waters of change flow harmoniously with the steadfast earth. The force of Death here purifies and grounds your transformation, enabling you to shed old limitations and emerge renewed, rooted in stability and enriched by enduring wisdom.
death.illDignified: The force of Death is distorted by the consuming flames of fire, igniting chaos and destruction rather than renewal. You face abrupt, uncontrolled upheaval that threatens to sever you from the natural cycle of transformation, fostering fear and resistance instead of acceptance and growth.

art.title: Art
meaning:
Sagittarius

Pour thine all freely from the Vase in thy right hand, and lose no drop. Hath not thy left hand a vase? Transmute all wholly into the Image of thy Will, bringing each to its true token of Perfection. Dissolve the Pearl in the Wine-cup; drink, and make manifest the Virtue of that Pearl.

Combination of forces, realisation, action based on accurate calculation; the way of escape, success after elaborate manoeuvres.
art.wellDignified: You stand at the crucible of harmonious transformation, where the fiery alchemy of Art blends seamlessly with the airy intellect of your surroundings. The force of synthesis is perfected here, enabling you to transmute disparate elements into a unified vision, manifesting your Will with clarity and inspired creativity. This is the exalted path of conscious creation, where calculated action leads to sublime realization.
art.illDignified: Beware, for the fiery essence of Art is drowned amidst the turbulent waters of emotional confusion and subconscious chaos. Your transformative efforts become muddled, misdirected by overwhelming feelings that erode clarity and distort purpose. The alchemical process falters, and what should be a deliberate synthesis devolves into aimless fusion, breeding frustration and spiritual disarray.

the-devil.title: The Devil
meaning:
Capricorn

With thy right Eye create all for thyself, and with the left accept all that be created otherwise.

Blind impulse, irresistibly strong and unscrupulous, ambition, temptation, obsession, secret plan about to be executed; hard work, obstinacy, rigidity, aching discontent, endurance.
the-devil.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of earthly mastery, where the force of your desire is harmonized with the fluidity of water, transforming obsession into profound emotional insight. The Devil’s energy is elevated, guiding you to channel ambition into creative and nurturing endeavors that deepen your connection to both self and others.
the-devil.illDignified: The force of the Devil is fractured by the hostile winds of air, scattering your focus into chaotic thoughts and deceptive rationalizations. This distortion breeds entrapment in mental illusions, where blind ambition turns into paranoia, manipulation, and the loss of true purpose.

the-tower.title: The Tower
meaning:
Mars

Break down the fortress of thine Individual Self, that thy Truth may spring free from the ruins.

Quarrel, combat, danger, ruin, destruction of plans, sudden death, escape from prison.
the-tower.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of transformative liberation, where the fiery force of Mars ignites a purifying blaze within the realm of Air. The Tower, when harmonized with the intellect and clarity of Air, dismantles illusory constructs with precise insight, enabling swift and conscious breakthroughs. This sacred destruction clears the path for enlightened understanding and the emergence of profound spiritual freedom.
the-tower.illDignified: The force of the Tower, when entangled with the turbulent currents of Water, becomes a tempestuous flood that overwhelms reason and judgment. Emotional chaos distorts the necessary upheaval, turning constructive destruction into self-destructive ruin and paralyzing fear. You face a storm where the collapse breeds despair, confusion, and a sense of drowning in the wreckage of shattered illusions.

the-star.title: The Star
meaning:
Aquarius

Use all thine energy to rule thy thought: burn up thy thought as the Phoenix.

Hope, unexpected help, clearness of vision, realisation of possibilities, spiritual insight, with bad aspects, error of judgment, dreaminess, disappointment.
the-star.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of visionary clarity, where the airy currents of intellect harmonize with the fiery spark of inspiration. The force of the Star ignites your spiritual insight, illuminating pathways of hope and transformation with unwavering certainty. This is the alchemical flame that refines thought into pure wisdom, guiding you toward your highest potential.
the-star.illDignified: The luminous promise of the Star falters under the oppressive weight of earth-bound skepticism and inertia. Your clarity becomes muddled, and the light of hope dims into the shadows of confusion and disappointment. Beware the seduction of dreamy illusions that cloud judgment and bind your spirit to stagnation.

the-moon.title: The Moon
meaning:
Pisces

Let the Illusion of the World pass over thee, unheeded, as thou goest from the Midnight to the Morning.

Illusion, deception, bewilderment, hysteria, even madness, dreaminess, falsehood, error, crisis, 'the darkest hour before the dawn', the brink of important change.
the-moon.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound intuition and emotional clarity. The force of Earth grounds the watery illusions of The Moon, guiding you to transcend deception and access deep inner wisdom. In this light, your dreams become visions of truth, illuminating the path from darkness to enlightenment.
the-moon.illDignified: The force of Fire ignites confusion into chaos, searing the delicate veil of The Moon's illusions into madness and hysteria. You risk losing yourself in falsehood and emotional turmoil, caught in a tempest where clarity is scorched away. Beware, for the darkest hour threatens to consume your reason before the dawn can break.

the-aeon.title: The Aeon
meaning:
Fire

Be every Act an Act of Love and Worship. Be every Act the Fiat of a God. Be every Act a Source of radiant Glory.

Final decision in respect of the past, new current in respect of the future; always represents the taking of a definite step.
the-aeon.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of divine transformation, where the fiery force of The Aeon ignites your spirit with clarity and purpose. Surrounded by air's intellect and vision, your every act becomes a conscious creation of radiant love and sacred will, propelling you toward your highest destiny with unwavering resolve.
the-aeon.illDignified: The force of The Aeon becomes turbulent and misdirected when clouded by the emotional depths of water. Your fiery will risks becoming destructive or blinded by sentiment, leading to rash decisions that sever you from true spiritual evolution and bind you to past illusions.

the-universe.title: The Universe
meaning:
Earth

Treat time and all conditions of Event as Servants of thy Will, appointed to present the Universe to thee in the form of thy Plan. And: blessing and worship to the prophet of the lovely Star.

The matter of the question itself, synthesis, the end of the matter, may mean delay, opposition, obstinacy, inertia, patience, perseverance, persistent stubbornness in difficulty. The crystallisation of the whole matter involved.
the-universe.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of manifestation, where the harmonious flow of Water elements amplifies the grounding Earth energy of The Universe. In this exalted state, synthesis becomes seamless, and the cosmic plan unfolds with grace, bringing fulfillment, completion, and the joyous integration of all parts into a perfect whole.
the-universe.illDignified: The force of hostile Air elements disrupts the solid foundation of The Universe, scattering the cohesive energy into confusion and fragmentation. You face resistance born of restless intellect and instability, where the crystallized vision dissolves into doubt, delay, and a paralyzing indecision that undermines perseverance.

2-of-wands.title: 2 of Wands
meaning:
Mars in Aries — Dominion

This card, pertaining to Chokmah in the suit of Fire, represents the Will in its most exalted form. It is an ideal Will, independent of any given object.

'For pure will, unassuaged of purpose, delivered from the lust of result, is every way perfect'. AL. 1. 44.

The background of this card shows the power of the planet Mars in his own sign Aries, the first of the Signs. It there represents Energy initiating a Current of Force. The pictorial representation is two Dorjes crossed. The Dorje is the Tibetan symbol of the thunderbolt, the emblem of celestial Power, but more in its destructive than its creative form. More, that is, in its earlier rather than its later form. For destruction may be regarded as the first step in the creative process. The virgin ovum must be broken in order to fertilise it. Fear and repulsion are therefore the primary reaction to the assault. Then, with understanding of the complete plan, willing surrender rejoices to co-operate. Six flames issue from the centre. This indicates the influence of the Sun, who is exalted in Aries. This is the creative Will.
2-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of dynamic creation, where your will is clear and purposeful, harmonizing with the intellectual clarity of Air. The force of Mars in Aries channels through inspired thought and decisive action, empowering you to initiate bold new ventures with confidence and strategic insight. In this exalted expression, your dominion is assured by the union of fiery energy and mental acuity, manifesting your vision with precision and strength.
2-of-wands.illDignified: The force of Mars in Aries becomes chaotic and destructive when overwhelmed by the turbulent currents of Water, distorting your will into impulsive aggression or emotional volatility. You risk losing sight of purpose as your energy is consumed by inner turmoil, leading to rash decisions and conflict. In this corrupted state, dominion slips away, replaced by frustration and a fragmented sense of power that undermines true mastery.

3-of-wands.title: 3 of Wands
meaning:
Sun in Aries — Virtue

This card refers to Binah in the suit of Fire, and so represents the establishment of primeval Energy. The Will has been trans mitted to the Mother, who conceives, prepares, and gives birth to, its manifestation. It refers to the Sun in Aries, the Sign in which he is exalted.

The meaning is harmonious, for this is the beginning of Spring. For this reason, one sees the wand taking the form of the Lotus in blossom. The Sun has enkindled the Great Mother.
3-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the dawn of dynamic creation, where your willpower and vision coalesce into purposeful action. The elemental air surrounds you, elevating your fiery intent into inspired leadership and clear strategic foresight. This is the radiant emergence of your potential, manifesting through confident initiative and harmonious expansion.
3-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your will flickers weakly and erratically under the dampening influence of water's chaotic currents. Your creative energy becomes muddled, confused by emotional turbulence and indecision, leading to frustrated efforts and stalled progress. Beware the stagnation born of conflicting desires and the erosion of your original purpose.

4-of-wands.title: 4 of Wands
meaning:
Venus in Aries — Completion

This card refers to Chesed in the suit of Fire. Being below the Abyss, it is the Lord of all manifested active Power. The original Will of the Two has been transmitted through the Three, and is now built up into a solid system: Order, Law, Government. It is also referred to Venus in Aries, which indicates that one cannot establish one's work without tact and gentleness. The wands are headed by the Ram, sacred to Chesed, the Father-god Amoun-Ra, as also to Aries; but at the other end of the wands are the Doves of Venus.

In the symbol, the ends of the wands touch a circle, showing the completion and limitation of the original work. It is within this circle that the flames (four double, as if to assert the balance) of the Energy are seen to play, and there is no intention to increase the scope of the original Will.
4-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the triumphant culmination of your creative endeavors, where fiery passion harmonizes with intellectual clarity. The force of Venus in Aries, amplified by the airy surroundings, manifests as joyous collaboration, inspired leadership, and the establishment of a radiant new order. This is the moment where your vision is not only realized but celebrated with grace and dynamic balance.
4-of-wands.illDignified: You face the turmoil of restless energy misdirected by overwhelming emotional currents, where the fiery drive of the Four of Wands clashes with the waters of doubt and confusion. The force that should bring completion and order becomes fragmented, leading to instability, premature endings, and a loss of clear purpose. Beware allowing passion to be drowned by emotional chaos, for the sacred flame risks flickering out.

5-of-wands.title: 5 of Wands
meaning:
Saturn in Leo — Strife

This card is referred to Geburah of the suit of Fire. Geburah itself being fiery, it is a purely active force. It is ruled also by Saturn and Leo. Leo shows the element of Fire at its strongest and most balanced. Saturn tends to weigh it down and to embitter it. There is no limit to the scope of this volcanic energy.

The symbol represents the wand of the Chief Adept, showing that the authority is derived from the superiors; were it not so, this card would be thoroughly disastrous. Moreover, there are also two wands of the Second, or Major Adept. They have the head of the Phoenix, which gives the idea of destruction (or rather purgation) through fire, and the resurrection of the energy from its ashes.
5-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the fiery crossroads of spirited challenge and noble competition, where the force of Saturn in Leo is masterfully balanced by the airy intellect surrounding it. This card reveals your ability to harness strife not as chaos, but as a crucible for growth, inspiring courage, leadership, and creative breakthroughs. Here, conflict refines your purpose and elevates your will to manifest greatness with clarity and controlled power.
5-of-wands.illDignified: The force of this card becomes turbulent and destructive when drowned by the watery tides of emotion and uncertainty. You face strife that is no longer a forging fire but a consuming storm of bitterness, jealousy, and confusion, where challenges breed resentment rather than growth. This distortion warns you of power misused, authority contested, and energies fragmented, leading to internal and external discord.

6-of-wands.title: 6 of Wands
meaning:
Jupiter in Leo — Victory

This card represents Tiphareth of the suit of Fire. This shows Energy in completely balanced manifestation. The Five has broken up the closed forces of the Four with revolutionary ardour, but a marriage has taken place between them; and the result is the Son, and the Sun.

The reference is also to Jupiter and Leo, which seems to imply a benediction on the harmony and beauty of this arrangement. It Will be seen that the Three Wands of the Three Adepts are now orderly arranged; and the flames themselves, instead of shooting out in all directions, burn steadily as in lamps. They are nine in number, in reference to Yesod and the Moon. This shows the stabilisation of the Energy, and its reception and reflection by the Feminine.

There is no circle to enclose the system. It is self-supporting, like the Sun.
6-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of radiant triumph, where the harmonious fire of Leo is exalted by the clarifying winds of Air. The force of Jupiter amplifies your victorious energy, bestowing benevolent leadership, enlightened confidence, and the power to inspire others with noble purpose. This is the achievement of greatness through balanced will, where your creative expression shines with unwavering brilliance and elevates all who witness it.
6-of-wands.illDignified: When engulfed by the turbulent waters, the vibrant fire of this card flickers and falters, its victorious flame threatened by overwhelming emotions and uncertainty. The force of Jupiter in Leo becomes distorted into prideful arrogance or reckless display, undermining true strength with vanity or instability. You face the peril of losing focus and harmony, where your radiant energy is dampened and your achievements risk dissolution in emotional chaos.

7-of-wands.title: 7 of Wands
meaning:
Mars in Leo — Valour

This card derives from Netzach (Victory) in the suit of Fire. But the Seven is a weak, earthy, feminine number as regards the Tree of Life, and represents a departure from the balance so low down on the Tree that this implies a loss of confidence.

Fortunately, the card is also attributed to Mars in Leo. The army has been thrown into disorder; if victory is to be won, it will be by dint of individual valour — a 'soldiers' battle'.
7-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of courageous assertion, where your fiery resolve is sharpened by the intellect and clarity of air. The force of Mars in Leo is refined into strategic bravery, allowing you to defend your ground with noble confidence and unwavering focus. In this exalted state, your valor is not mere bravado but a conscious, masterful expression of inner strength and leadership.
7-of-wands.illDignified: The force of Mars in Leo is clouded and disrupted when overwhelmed by the fluid confusion of water, leading to reckless aggression born of insecurity and fear. You may find yourself embroiled in chaotic struggles, your courage devolving into stubborn obstinacy or destructive pride. This distortion breeds isolation, where valour becomes a desperate, lonely fight against unseen tides.

8-of-wands.title: 8 of Wands
meaning:
Mercury in Sagittarius — Swiftness

The card refers to Hod, splendour, in the suit of Fire, whence it refers to the phenomena of speech, light, electricity. The pictorial representation of the card shows the Light-wands turned into electrical rays, sustaining or even constituting Matter by their vibrating energy. Above this restored universe shines the rainbow; the division of pure light, which deals with maxima, into the seven colours of the spectrum, which exhibit interplay and correlation.

This card, therefore, represents energy of high velocity, such as furnishes the master-key to modern mathematical physics.
8-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the nexus of swift intellect and radiant communication, where the fiery energy of the 8 of Wands ignites your mental faculties with lucidity and purpose. The force of Mercury in Sagittarius, empowered by the elemental air, channels rapid insights and eloquent expression, propelling your endeavors with clarity and precision. In this exalted state, your actions and words fuse seamlessly, manifesting transformative progress and enlightened understanding.
8-of-wands.illDignified: The force of the 8 of Wands, when battered by the opposing tides of water, becomes erratic and unfocused, like electrical currents short-circuiting in a storm. You may experience confusion, miscommunication, or impulsive decisions that scatter your energies rather than harness them. This distortion undermines the card's inherent swiftness, reducing its power to chaotic flashes that hinder rather than illuminate your path.

9-of-wands.title: 9 of Wands
meaning:
Moon in Sagittarius — Strength

This card is referred to Yesod, the Foundation; this brings the Energy back into balance. The Nine represents always the fullest development of the Force in its relation with the Forces above it. The Nine may be considered as the best that can be obtained from the type involved, regarded from a practical and material standpoint. This card is also governed by the Moon in Sagittarius; so here is a double influence of the Moon on the Tree of Life. Hence the aphorism 'Change is Stability'.

The Wands have now become arrows. There are eight of them in the background, and in front of them one master arrow. This has the Moon for its point, and the Sun for the driving Force above it; for the path of Sagittarius on the Tree of Life joins the Sun and Moon. The flames in the card are tenfold, implying that the Energy is directed downwards.
9-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of mastery and resilience, where your inner strength shines with clarity and purpose. The harmonious air element elevates your courage and determination, enabling you to wield your willpower with wisdom and precision. This is the moment where steadfastness becomes enlightened action, and your efforts manifest as triumphant progress.
9-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your resolve is muddied by the waters of emotional turbulence, causing confusion and hesitation to cloud your judgment. Your strength wavers under the weight of doubt and fear, leading to defensive rigidity or reckless exhaustion. Beware, for without clear focus, your perseverance may turn into stubbornness or self-inflicted limitation.

10-of-wands.title: 10 of Wands
meaning:
Saturn in Sagittarius — Oppression

The number Ten refers to Malkuth, which depends from the other nine Sephiroth, but is not directly in communication with them. It shows the Force detached from its spiritual sources. It is become a blind Force; so, the most violent form of that particular energy, without any modifying influences. The flames in the back ground of the card have run wild. It is Fire in its most destructive aspect.

The whole picture suggests Oppression and repression. It is a stupid and obstinate cruelty from which there is no escape. It is a Will which has not understood anything beyond its dull purpose, its 'lust of result', and will devour itself in the conflagrations it has evoked.
10-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the summit of determined will, where your focused energy channels fiery ambition into purposeful action. The oppressive weight transforms into disciplined mastery, allowing you to bear responsibility with strength and clarity, forging a path of constructive leadership and achievement.
10-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your will becomes a destructive tempest, overwhelmed by emotional turmoil and confusion. Oppression twists into self-inflicted suffering and stagnation, as your blind drive clashes with fluctuating currents, leading to exhaustion and despair without release.

princess-of-wands.title: Princess of Wands
meaning:
The Princess of Wands represents the earthy part of Fire; one might say, she is the fuel of Fire. This expression implies the irresistible chemical attraction of the combustible substance. The Princess is therefore shewn with the plumes of justice streaming like flames from her brow; and she is unclothed, shewing that chemical action can only take place when the element is perfectly free to combine with its partner.

This card may be said to represent the dance of the virgin priestess of the Lords of Fire, for she is in attendance upon the golden altar ornamented with rams' heads) symbolising the fires of Spring. The character of the Princess is extremely individual. She is brilliant and daring. She creates her own beauty by her essential vigour and energy. The force of her character imposes the impression of beauty upon the beholder. In anger or love she is sudden, violent, and implacable. She consumes all that comes into her sphere. She is ambitious and aspiring, full of enthusiasm which is often irrational. She never forgets an injury, and the only quality of patience to be found in her is the patience with which she lies in ambush to avenge.
princess-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of inspired creation, where the elemental fire is fanned by the breath of air, igniting your imagination and will with clarity and purpose. The Princess of Wands, in harmonious air, becomes a radiant emissary of dynamic intellect and courage, manifesting visionary ideas with confident, decisive action.
princess-of-wands.illDignified: The force of the Princess of Wands is dampened by the overwhelming tides of water, causing her fiery energy to smolder into frustration and confusion. You may find your creative impulse stifled, your daring reduced to impulsiveness or reckless emotional outbursts, as the vital flame struggles against the quenching currents of doubt and insecurity.

prince-of-wands.title: Prince of Wands
meaning:
Leo

The moral qualities appropriate to this figure are swiftness and strength. But he is sometimes inclined to act on impulse; sometimes easily led by external influences; sometimes, especially in trifles, a prey to indecision. He is often violent, especially in the expression of an opinion, but he does not necessarily hold the opinion about which he is so emphatic. He states a vigorous proposition for the sake of stating it. He is in fact very slow to make up his mind thoroughly on any subject, but always sees both sides of every question. He is essentially just, but always feels that justice is not to be attained in the intellectual world. His character is intensely noble and generous.

He may be an extravagant boaster, while slyly laughing both at the object of his boast and at himself for making it. One of his greatest faults is pride; meanness and pettiness of any kind he holds in infinite scorn. His courage is fanatically strong, and his endurance indefatigable. He is always fighting against odds, and always wins in the long — the very long-run. This is principally due to his enormous capacity for work, which he exercises for its own sake, 'without lust of result'.
prince-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of fiery resolve, where your swift action is guided by clear intellect and noble purpose. The Prince of Wands manifests as a courageous leader, whose strength is tempered by justice and whose enthusiasm inspires transformative change. In this harmonious elemental alignment, your impulses are refined into decisive, visionary acts that blaze new trails with confident integrity.
prince-of-wands.illDignified: The force of the Prince of Wands is distorted, becoming erratic and impulsive under the dampening influence of water. You may find yourself overwhelmed by emotional turbulence, leading to rash decisions driven by pride or insecurity rather than wisdom. This imbalance breeds conflict and confusion, where noble intentions are lost in a storm of indecision and destructive outbursts.

queen-of-wands.title: Queen of Wands
meaning:
Aries

The Queen of Wands represents the watery part of Fire, its fluidity and colour. Also, she rules in the Zodiac from the 21st degree of Pisces to the 20th degree of Aries. Her crown is topped with the winged globe and rayed with flame. She is seated upon a throne of flame, ordered into geometrical light by her material power. Beneath the throne the surging flames are steady. She bears a wand in her left hand; but it is topped with a cone suggestive of the mysteries of Bacchus. She is attended by a couchant leopard upon whose head she lays her hand. Her face expresses the ecstasy of one whose mind is well in-drawn to the mystery borne beneath her bosom.

The characteristics of the Queen are adaptability, persistent energy, calm authority which she knows how to use to enhance her attractiveness. She is kindly and generous, but impatient of opposition. She has immense capacity for friendship and for love, but always on her own initiative.
queen-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the nexus of vibrant creativity and assured leadership, where the fiery energy of the Queen of Wands is harmoniously balanced by the intellectual clarity of air. This alignment inspires you to wield your personal power with wisdom and grace, manifesting your will through inspired action and clear communication that uplifts and enlightens those around you.
queen-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your fiery authority becomes turbulent and erratic when confronted by the encroaching depths of water's emotional currents. Your passionate drive risks being overwhelmed by confusion, moodiness, or manipulative tendencies, obscuring your true strength and leaving you vulnerable to inner turmoil and external discord.

knight-of-wands.title: Knight of Wands
meaning:
Sagittarius

The Knight of Wands represents the fiery part of Fire. He is a warrior in complete armour. On his helmet for a crest, he wears a black horse. In his hand he bears a flaming torch; a flame also in his mantle; and upon the flames does he ride. His steed is a black horse leaping.

The moral qualities appropriate to this figure are activity, generosity, fierceness, impetuosity, pride, impulsiveness, swiftness in unpredictable actions. If wrongly energised, he is evil-minded, cruel, bigoted and brutal. He is in either case ill-fitted to carry on his action; he has no means of modifying it according to circumstances. If he fails in his first effort, he has no recourse.
knight-of-wands.wellDignified: You stand at the zenith of fiery action, where your impetuous spirit is tempered by intellectual clarity and swift discernment. The Knight of Wands, harmonized with Air, channels his fierce energy into purposeful leadership and inspired innovation, manifesting courage that ignites transformation without recklessness.
knight-of-wands.illDignified: The force of your fiery impulse is drowned in turbulent waters, where passion becomes confusion and swiftness turns to chaos. The Knight of Wands, subdued by Water, manifests as destructive pride and impulsivity unchecked by wisdom, leading to cruelty, bitterness, and a loss of direction in the storm of emotions.

2-of-cups.title: 2 of Cups
meaning:
Venus in Cancer — Love

The Two always represents the Word and the Will. It is the first manifestation. Therefore, in the suit of Water, it must refer to Love, which recovers unity from dividuality by mutual annihilation. The card also refers to Venus in Cancer. Cancer is, more than any other, the receptive Sign; it is the House of the Moon, and in that Sign Jupiter is exalted. These are, superficially, the three most friendly of the planets.

The hieroglyph of the card represents two cups in the foreground, overflowing upon a calm sea. They are fed with lucent water from a lotus floating upon the sea, from which rises another lotus around whose stem are entwined twin dolphins.

The number Two referring to Will, this card might really be renamed the Lord of Love under Will, for that is its full and true meaning. It shows the harmony of the male and the female: interpreted in the largest sense. It is perfect and placid harmony, radiating an intensity of joy and ecstasy.
2-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of harmonious union, where the force of love is grounded in stability and manifestation. When strengthened by the earthly element, the Two of Cups becomes the purest expression of heartfelt commitment and nurturing partnership, manifesting as enduring bonds that foster growth and mutual support.
2-of-cups.illDignified: The force of love becomes turbulent and distorted when confronted by the fiery element. This ill-dignified Two of Cups warns of emotional volatility, impulsiveness, and the fracturing of relationships through passion untempered by understanding, leading to disunion and inner turmoil.

3-of-cups.title: 3 of Cups
meaning:
Mercury in Cancer — Abundance

This card refers to Binah in the suit of Water. This is the card of Demeter or Persephone. The Cups are pomegranates: they are filled bountifully to overflowing a single lotus, arising from the dark calm sea characteristic of Binah. There is here the fulfilment of the Will of Love in abounding joy. It is the spiritual basis of fertility.

The card is referred to the influence of Mercury in Cancer; this carries further the above thesis. Mercury is the Will or Word of the All-Father; here its influence descends upon the most receptive of the Signs. At the same time, the combination of these forms of energy brings in the possibility of somewhat mysterious ideas. Binah, the Great Sea, is the Moon in one aspect, but Saturn in another; and Mercury, besides being the Word or Will of the All-One, is the guide of the souls of the Dead. The pomegranate was the fruit which Persephone ate in the realms of Pluto, thereby enabling him to hold her in the lower world, even after the most powerful influence had been brought to bear. The lesson seems to be that the good things of life, although enjoyed, should be distrusted.
3-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of emotional abundance and nurturing creativity, where the fertile energies of Earth solidify the flowing waters of the Cups. The force of Mercury in Cancer, amplified by the grounding influence of Earth, manifests as a harmonious union of intellect and intuition, bringing forth fruitful ideas, deep emotional bonds, and tangible manifestations of love's will. This is the pinnacle of joyful fulfillment and spiritual fertility, where your intentions bear lasting and nourishing results.
3-of-cups.illDignified: The force of this card becomes turbulent and fragmented when surrounded by the fiery impulsiveness of hostile elements. Your will to nurture and communicate is distorted into emotional volatility and capriciousness, leading to misunderstandings and unstable relationships. The natural flow of abundance is blocked, and the Cup's overflowing bounty turns into a restless surge of ungrounded desires, threatening the sacred balance of love and will.

4-of-cups.title: 4 of Cups
meaning:
Moon in Cancer — Luxury

This card refers to Chesed in the sphere of Water. Here, below the Abyss, the energy of this element, although ordered, balanced and (for the moment) stabilised, has lost the original purity of the conception. The card refers to the Moon in Cancer, which is her own house; but Cancer itself is so placed that this implies a certain weakness, an abandonment to desire. This tends to introduce the seeds of decay into the fruit of pleasure.

The sea is still shown, but its surface is ruffled, and the four Cups which stand upon it are no longer so stable. The Lotus from which the water Springs has a multiple stem, as if to show that the influence of the Dyad has gathered strength.
4-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of emotional fulfillment, where the nurturing waters of Cancer harmonize with the grounding Earth. The force of luxury and pleasure is refined into steady, enduring comfort, fostering growth in personal relationships and inner peace. Here, desire is tempered by stability, allowing you to cultivate lasting joy and deep emotional security.
4-of-cups.illDignified: The force of unchecked desire surges chaotically, as the fiery energy disrupts the fragile balance of the Cups. You risk being consumed by emotional instability, indulgence, and decay, where fleeting pleasures give way to dissatisfaction and inner turmoil. Beware the abandonment to passion that corrodes the foundation of true contentment.

5-of-cups.title: 5 of Cups
meaning:
Mars in Scorpio — Disappointment

This card is ruled by Geburah in the suit of Water. Geburah being fiery, there is a natural antipathy. Hence arises the idea of disturbance, just when least expected, in a time of ease. The attribution is also to Mars in Scorpio, which is his own house; and Mars is the manifestation on the lowest plane of Geburah, while Scorpio, in its worst aspect, suggests the putrefying power of Water.

Yet the powerful male influences do not show actual decay, only the beginning of destruction; hence, the anticipated pleasure is frustrated. The Lotuses have their petals torn by fiery winds; the sea is arid and stagnant, a dead sea, like a 'chott' in North Africa. No water flows into the cups. Moreover, these cups are arranged in the form of an inverted pentagram, symbolising the triumph of matter over spirit.
5-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound emotional transformation, where the steadfast earth stabilizes the turbulent waters of Mars in Scorpio. The force of Geburah channels disciplined passion into constructive change, allowing you to release past disappointments and cultivate resilience and inner strength with clarity and purpose.
5-of-cups.illDignified: The force of fiery aggression agitates the already turbulent waters, distorting the potent energies of Mars in Scorpio into destructive obsession and emotional chaos. You are warned against succumbing to bitterness and destructive impulses, as unchecked fire inflames wounds and deepens the sense of loss and frustration.

6-of-cups.title: 6 of Cups
meaning:
Sun in Scorpio — Pleasure

This card shows the influence of the number Six, Tiphareth, in the suit of Water. This influence is fortified by that of the Sun, who also represents the Six. The whole image is that of the influence of the Sun on Water.

The lotus stems are grouped in an elaborate dancing movement. From their blossoms water gushes into the Cups, but they are not yet full to overflowing, as they are in the corresponding card below; the Nine. Pleasure, in the title of this card, must be understood in its highest sense: it implies well-being, harmony of natural forces without effort or strain, ease, satisfaction. Foreign to the idea of the card is the gratification of natural or artificial desires. Yet it does represent emphatically the fulfilment of the sexual Will, as shown by the ruling Sephira, planet, element, and sign.
6-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the harmonious confluence of water and earth, where the pleasure of the Six of Cups is grounded in material stability and fertile growth. The Sun in Scorpio's influence is enhanced, revealing a profound well-being that arises from the fruitful integration of emotional depth and practical manifestation. This is the fulfillment of the sexual Will as a creative, sustaining force that nurtures life and spirit alike.
6-of-cups.illDignified: The force of the Six of Cups is challenged when surrounded by the fiery element, igniting passions that overwhelm the card's inherent harmony and ease. Pleasure becomes distorted into reckless indulgence or destructive desire, severing the natural flow of the sexual Will and breeding turmoil instead of satisfaction. You must beware the corrosion of true fulfillment by the aggressive flames of uncontrolled emotion.

7-of-cups.title: 7 of Cups
meaning:
Venus in Scorpio — Debauch

This card refers to the Seven, Netzach, in the suit of Water. Here recurs the invariable weakness arising from lack of balance; also, the card is governed by Venus in Scorpio. Her dignity is not good in this Sign; one is reminded that Venus is the planet of Copper, 'external splendour and internal corruption'. The Lotuses have become poisonous, looking like tiger-lilies; and, instead of water, green slime issues from them and overflows, making the Sea a malarious morass. It is a wholesome reminder of the fatal ease with which a Sacrament may be profaned and prostituted.
7-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of transformative emotional clarity, where the deep currents of Venus in Scorpio nourish profound passion and healing. The poisonous illusions dissolve, revealing the sacred depths of love and creativity, purified by the stabilizing influence of Earth. This card's energy, when well-dignified, calls you to embrace intense emotional truths and channel them into lasting, constructive bonds and artistic expression.
7-of-cups.illDignified: The force of this card becomes a maelstrom of toxic desire and self-deception when surrounded by the aggressive flames of Fire. The allure of Venus in Scorpio turns corrosive, manifesting as manipulative seduction, obsession, and emotional ruin. You are warned that without balance, you risk succumbing to the debauchery of corrupted passion, where the sacred is profaned and your soul ensnared in malarious illusions.

8-of-cups.title: 8 of Cups
meaning:
Saturn in Pisces — Indolence

Lotuses droop for lack of sun and rain, and the soil is poison to them; only two of the stems show blossoms at all. The cups are shallow, old and broken. They are arranged in three rows; of these the upper row of three is quite empty. Water trickles from the two flowers into the two central cups, and they drip into the two lowest without filling them. The background of the card shows pools, or lagoons, in very extensive country, incapable of cultivation; only disease and miasma tic poison can flourish in those vast Bad Lands. The water is dark and muddy. On the horizon is a pallid, yellowish light, weighed down by leaden clouds of indigo.
8-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound emotional discipline, where Saturn's structure harmonizes with the fertile earth. The indolence represented by the 8 of Cups transforms into a deliberate, meditative retreat, enabling deep healing and the cultivation of inner wisdom. In this state, you harness the power of stillness to cleanse toxic influences and nurture spiritual growth.
8-of-cups.illDignified: The force of the fiery element ignites restlessness and frustration within the watery depths of the 8 of Cups, distorting its intent. Indolence devolves into destructive escapism or emotional stagnation fueled by impulsive actions. You may find yourself trapped in a mire of toxic emotions, unable to face the necessary inner work, as the chaotic fire consumes the subtle currents of reflection.

9-of-cups.title: 9 of Cups
meaning:
Jupiter in Pisces — Happiness

The Number Nine, Yesod, in the suit of Water, restores the stability lost by the excursions of Netzach and Hod from the Middle Pillar. It is also the number of the Moon, thus strengthening the idea of Water.

In this card is the pageant of the culmination and perfection of the original force of Water. In the symbol are nine cups perfectly arranged in a square; all are filled and overflowing with Water. It is the most complete and most beneficent aspect of the force of Water.
9-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the zenith of emotional fulfillment, where the nurturing currents of Earth amplify the gentle tides of Water. The Nine of Cups manifests as a sanctuary of joy and contentment, inviting you to bask in the harmonious union of material abundance and spiritual happiness. This is the card of heartfelt wishes realized and the serene completion of emotional quests.
9-of-cups.illDignified: The force of Water is disturbed when confronted by the aggressive flames of Fire, causing emotional turbulence and dissatisfaction. Under this harsh influence, the Nine of Cups warns of fleeting pleasures, indulgence without nourishment, and the hollow echo of desires unfulfilled. You must beware illusions of happiness that mask deeper unrest.

10-of-cups.title: 10 of Cups
meaning:
Mars in Pisces — Satiety

This card represents a conflicting element. On the one hand, it receives the influence of the Ten, Malkah the Virgin. The arrangement of the cups is that of the Tree of Life. But, on the other hand, they are themselves unstable. They are tilted; they spill the water from the great Lotus which overhangs the whole system from one into the other. The work proper to water is complete: and disturbance is due.
10-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of emotional fulfillment and spiritual harmony. The force of Mars in Pisces, tempered by the stabilizing earth element, manifests as profound inner peace and the joyful completion of your emotional journey. Here, the overflowing cups symbolize a sacred abundance that nurtures not only yourself but all those around you, reflecting a perfect union of desire and divine grace.
10-of-cups.illDignified: The force of Mars in Pisces becomes turbulent and fragmented when confronted with the disruptive nature of fire. You face emotional instability and the shattering of illusions, where the overflowing cups spill chaos rather than blessing. This corruption breeds dissatisfaction and spiritual unrest, warning you of potential emotional burnout and the loss of harmonious balance.

princess-of-cups.title: Princess of Cups
meaning:
The Princess of Cups represents the earthy part of Water; in particular, the faculty of crystallisation. She represents the power of Water to give substance to idea, to support life, and to form the basis of chemical combination. She is represented as a dancing figure, robed in a flowing garment on whose edges crystals are seen to form.

For her crest she wears a swan with open wings. The symbolism of this swan reminds one of the swan in oriental philosophy which is the word AUM or AUMGN, which is the symbol of the entire process of creation. She bears a covered cup from which issues a tortoise. This is again the tortoise which in Hindu philosophy supports the elephant on whose back is the Universe. She is dancing upon a foaming sea in which disports himself a dolphin, the royal fish, which symbolises the power of Creation. The character of the Princess is infinitely gracious. All sweetness, all voluptuousness, gentleness, kindness and tenderness are in her character. She lives in the world of Romance, in the perpetual dream of rapture. On a superficial examination she might be thought selfish and indolent, but this is a quite false impression; silently and effortlessly she goes about her work.
princess-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of profound emotional alchemy, where the fertile earth stabilizes the fluid currents of water within you. The Princess of Cups manifests as a nurturer of dreams and visions, bringing clarity and form to your innermost feelings. In this state, your intuitive insights crystallize into tangible creativity, fostering harmony between your heart and the material world.
princess-of-cups.illDignified: The force of fire clashes with the fluid essence of the Princess, igniting turmoil within your emotional landscape. Here, her power to give form to feeling becomes distorted into confusion and emotional volatility, as passion overwhelms reason and stability. You risk dissolving the delicate balance between inspiration and reality, resulting in impulsive actions and fractured relationships.

prince-of-cups.title: Prince of Cups
meaning:
Scorpio

The Prince of Cups represents the airy part of Water. On the one hand, elasticity, volatility, hydrostatic equilibrium; on the other hand, the catalytic faculty and the energy of steam. He is a warrior partly clad in armour, which seems, however, rather a growth than a covering. His helmet is surmounted by an eagle, and his chariot, which resembles a shell, is also drawn by an eagle. His wings are tenuous, almost of gas. This is a reference to his power of volatilisation understood in the spiritual sense. The whole symbolism of this card is exceedingly complicated, for Scorpio is the most mysterious of the Signs, and the manifested portion of it symbolised by the eagle is in reality the least important part of his nature.

The moral characteristics of the person pictured in this card are subtlety, secret violence, and craft. He is intensely secret, an artist in all his ways. On the surface he appears calm and imperturbable, but this is a mask of the most intense passion. He is on the surface susceptible to external influences, but he accepts them only to transmute them to the advantage of his secret designs. He is thus completely without conscience in the ordinary sense of the word, and is therefore usually distrusted by his neighbours. They feel they do not, and can never, understand him. Thus, he inspires unreasonable fear. He is in fact perfectly ruthless. He cares intensely for power, wisdom, and his own aims.
prince-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the confluence of Water and Earth, where the Prince of Cups manifests as a harmonious alchemist of emotions and stability. His volatile waters are tempered and given form, allowing your intuitive insights to crystallize into practical wisdom and compassionate action. In this exalted state, you embody emotional resilience and the power to transform feelings into nurturing strength.
prince-of-cups.illDignified: The force of Fire surrounding the Prince of Cups ignites his waters into turbulent storms, distorting his essence into emotional volatility and destructive passion. You may find yourself engulfed by impulsive desires and inner chaos, where sensitivity becomes hypersensitivity, and intuition is clouded by agitation. Beware the corrosion of your emotional core, lest the catalytic energy of steam turns into scalding fury.

queen-of-cups.title: Queen of Cups
meaning:
Cancer

The Queen of Cups represents the watery part of Water, its power of reception and reflection. She reflects the nature of the observer in great perfection. She is represented as enthroned upon still water. In her hand she bears a shell-like cup, from which issues a crayfish, and she bears also the Lotus of Isis, of the Great Mother. She is robed in, and veiled by, endless curves of light, and the sea upon which she is enthroned conveys the almost unbroken images of the image which she represents.

The characteristics associated with this card are principally dreaminess, illusion and tranquillity. She is the perfect agent and patient, able to receive and transmit everything without herself being affected thereby. If ill-dignified, all these qualities are degraded. Everything that passes through her is refracted and distorted. But, speaking generally, her characteristics depend mostly upon the influences which affect her.
queen-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the confluence of Water and Earth, where the Queen of Cups manifests as profound emotional wisdom grounded in practical reality. Her receptive and reflective nature is harmonized, allowing you to nurture and heal with unwavering stability and compassionate insight, fostering growth in both spirit and matter.
queen-of-cups.illDignified: The force of Fire surrounding the Queen of Cups ignites turmoil within her tranquil depths, distorting her serene reflection into chaotic illusion and emotional volatility. You may find yourself overwhelmed by tempestuous passions and deceptive feelings, where the power to receive is corrupted into reactive instability and confusion.

knight-of-cups.title: Knight of Cups
meaning:
Pisces

The Knight of Cups represents the fiery part of Water, the swift passionate attack of rain and springs; more intimately, Water's power of solution. He is clothed in black armour furnished with bright wings which, together with the leaping attitude of his white charger, indicates that he represents the most active aspect of Water. In his right hand he bears a cup from which issues a crab, the cardinal sign of Water, for aggressiveness. His totem is the peacock, for one of the stigmata of water in its most active form is brilliance. There is here also some reference to the phenomena of fluorescence.

The characteristics of the person signified by this card are nevertheless mostly passive, in accordance with the Zodiacal attribution. He is graceful, dilettante, with the qualities of Venus, or a weak Jupiter. He is amiable in a passive way. He is quick to respond to attraction, and easily becomes enthusiastic under such stimulus; but he is not very enduring. He is exceedingly sensitive to external in fluence, but with no material depth in his character.
knight-of-cups.wellDignified: You stand at the confluence of Water and Earth, where emotions find fertile ground to manifest as tangible creativity and nurturing. The Knight of Cups, strengthened by Earth, channels his passionate currents into steadfast devotion and practical artistry, embodying inspired sensitivity grounded in reality.
knight-of-cups.illDignified: The force of fiery aggression clashes with the fluid nature of the Knight of Cups, distorting his gentle purpose into volatile emotional outbursts and reckless idealism. Surrounded by Fire, his waters become tempestuous floods, eroding stability and breeding confusion where clarity and compassion should prevail.

ace-of-swords.title: Ace of Swords
meaning:
The Root of Air

The Ace of Swords is the primordial Energy of Air, the Essence of the Vau of Tetragrammaton, the integration of the Ruach. Air is the result of the conjunction of Fire and Water; thus, it lacks the purity of its superiors in the male hierarchy, Fire, Sol and the Phallus. But for this same reason it is the first card directly to be apprehended by the normal consciousness of Mankind.

In nature, the obvious symbol of Air is the Wind 'which bloweth whithersoever it listeth'. It lacks the concentrated Will of Fire to unite with Water: it has no corresponding passion for its Twin Element, Earth. There is indeed, a notable passivity in its nature; evidently, it has no self-generated impulse. But, set in motion by its Father and Mother, its power is manifestly terrific. It visibly attacks its objective, as they, being of subtler and more tenuous character, can never do. Its 'all-embracing, all-wandering, all-penetrating, all-consuming' qualities have been described by many admirable writers, and its analogies are for the most part patent to quite ordinary observers.
ace-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of clarity and decisive intellect, where the sharpness of your mind cuts through confusion like a sword through mist. The force of Fire ignites the Air, empowering your thoughts with passion and purpose, enabling you to wield truth and justice with unwavering will and insightful communication.
ace-of-swords.illDignified: The force of Earth suppresses the airy intellect, grounding your thoughts into stagnation and confusion. You risk becoming ensnared in rigid dogma or overwhelmed by doubt, where the sword dulls and fragments, symbolizing distorted reasoning, harsh judgment, and the loss of mental agility.

2-of-swords.title: 2 of Swords
meaning:
Moon in Libra — Peace

The Moon is change, but Nature is peaceful; moreover, Libra represents balance; between them, they regulate the energy of the Swords.

In the card appear two swords crossed; they are united by a blue rose with five petals. This rose represents the influence of the Mother, whose harmonising influence compounds the latent antagonism native to the suit. The Rose emits white rays, producing a geometrical pattern that emphasises the equilibrium of the symbol.
2-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of true harmony, where the force of air and fire combine to illuminate your intellect and will. This card, empowered by fire's dynamic energy, reveals a moment of decisive clarity and balanced action, enabling you to resolve conflicts with grace and strategic insight. The crossed swords become instruments of enlightened peace, guiding you to mastery over opposition through conscious equilibrium.
2-of-swords.illDignified: The force of air constrained by earth breeds stagnation and rigid conflict within you. Here, the peaceful balance of the swords is corrupted into indecision or false compromise, where mental energies are trapped beneath heavy material concerns or dogmatic resistance. You risk being ensnared in internal strife, unable to reconcile opposing forces, and thus lose the potential for true peace and resolution.

3-of-swords.title: 3 of Swords
meaning:
Saturn in Libra — Sorrow

This card is dark and heavy; it is, so to speak, the womb of Chaos. There is an intense lurking passion to create, but its children are monsters. This may mean the supreme transcendence of the natural order. Secrecy is here, and Perversion.

The symbol represents the great Sword of the Magician, point uppermost; it cuts the junction of two short curved swords. The impact has destroyed the rose. In the background, storm broods under implacable night.
3-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the crucible of transformative clarity, where the sharp intellect of Air is ignited by the purifying fire of passion. The force of sorrow is transmuted into profound insight, enabling you to sever illusions and embrace necessary endings that clear the path for renewal and justice. Here, the dark wounds become gateways to wisdom and the rebirth of harmony within chaos.
3-of-swords.illDignified: The force of sorrow becomes a suffocating weight when Earth’s rigidity suppresses the breath of Air’s truth. You are trapped in a web of bitterness and stagnation, where grief festers into paranoia and the mind is clouded by distorted perceptions. In this state, the sword’s cutting power is blunted, and the potential for healing is obscured by the heavy chains of despair and denial.

4-of-swords.title: 4 of Swords
meaning:
Jupiter in Libra — Truce

Chesed refers to Jupiter who rules in Libra in this decanate. The sum of these symbols is therefore without opposition; hence the card proclaims the idea of authority in the intellectual world. It is the establishment of dogma, and law concerning it. It represents a refuge from mental chaos, chosen in an arbitrary manner. It argues for convention.

The hilts of the four Swords are at the corner of a St. Andrew's cross. Their shape suggests fixation and rigidity. Their points are sheathed — in a rather large rose of forty-nine petals representing social harmony. Here, too, is compromise.

Minds too indolent or too cowardly to think out their own problems hail joyfully this policy of appeasement. As always, the Four is the term; as in this case there is no true justification for repose, its disturbance by the Five holds no promise of advance; its static shams go pell-mell into the melting-pot; the issue is mere mess, usually signalised by foetid stench. But it has to be done!
4-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of intellectual harmony, where the force of Jupiter in Libra is magnified by the fiery element. Here, mental authority is not rigid dogma but enlightened wisdom, fostering true compromise and balanced negotiation. Your mind becomes a sanctuary of constructive ideas, inspiring decisive yet fair resolutions that elevate social order and personal integrity.
4-of-swords.illDignified: The force of the Four of Swords becomes a prison of inflexible thought when burdened by the earth's weight. You risk entrapment in stagnant dogma, where fear of change breeds intellectual cowardice and oppressive convention. The rose of social harmony withers, replaced by conflict and mental paralysis, as the promise of truce dissolves into rigid, unyielding compromise.

5-of-swords.title: 5 of Swords
meaning:
Venus in Aquarius — Defeat

The intellect has been enfeebled by sentiment. The defeat is due to pacifism. Treachery also may be implied.

The hilts of the swords form the inverted pentagram, always a symbol of somewhat sinister tendency. Here matters are even worse; none of the hilts resembles any of the others, and their blades are crooked or broken. They give the impression of drooping; only the lowest of the swords points upwards, and this is the least effective of the weapons. The rose of the previous card has been altogether disintegrated.
5-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the crossroads of intellect and idealism, where the airy energy of fire refines your thoughts into visionary strategies. The defeat here transforms into a noble surrender, allowing you to release outdated beliefs and embrace innovative solutions with clarity and courage. Your mind becomes a beacon of progressive change, transcending petty conflicts for the greater good.
5-of-swords.illDignified: The force of earth weighs heavily upon your intellect, grounding your airy ideals into rigid dogma and bitter resentment. Defeat festers into treachery and despair, as your thoughts become entangled in jealousy and stubbornness. You risk losing sight of the higher purpose, trapped in a web of self-defeating pride and fractured alliances.

6-of-swords.title: 6 of Swords
meaning:
Mercury in Aquarius — Science

Tiphareth shows the full establishment and balance of the idea of the suit. This is particularly the case with this card, as the intellect itself is also referred to the number Six. Mercury, in Aquarius, represents the celestial Energy influencing the Kerub of the Man, thus showing intelligence and humanity.

But there is much more than this in the symbol. The perfect balance of all mental and moral faculties, hardly won, and almost impossible to hold in an ever-changing world, declares the idea of Science in its fullest interpretation.
