The hilts of the Swords, which are very ornamental, are in the form of the hexagram. Their points touch the outer petals of a red rose upon a golden cross of six squares, thus showing the Rosy Cross as the central secret of scientific truth.
6-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of intellectual clarity and innovation, where the swift currents of Air are energized by the passionate sparks of Fire. The force of Mercury in Aquarius here manifests as inspired scientific insight and revolutionary ideas that elevate humanity. This is the harmonious union of mind and will, enabling you to apply knowledge with precision and visionary purpose.
6-of-swords.illDignified: You face the stagnation of intellect, where the fluid energy of Air is burdened and constrained by the dense inertia of Earth. The force of Mercury in Aquarius becomes muddled, leading to confused thinking, rigid dogma, or cold detachment devoid of empathy. In this state, the pursuit of knowledge is corrupted into misguided skepticism or intellectual arrogance that isolates rather than enlightens.

7-of-swords.title: 7 of Swords
meaning:
Moon in Aquarius — Futility

Netzach, in the suit of Swords, does not represent such catastrophe as in the other suits, for Netzach, the Sephira of Venus, means victory. There is, therefore, a modifying influence; and this is accentuated by the celestial rule of the Moon in Aquarius.

The intellectual wreckage of the card is thus not so vehement as in the Five. There is vacillation, a wish to compromise, a certain toleration. But, in certain circumstances, the results may be more disastrous than ever. This naturally depends upon the success of the policy. This is always in doubt as long as there exist violent, uncompromising forces which take it as a natural prey. This card, like the Four, suggests the policy of appeasement.

The symbol shows six Swords with their hilts in crescent formation. Their points meet below the centre of the card, impinging upon a blade of a much larger up-thrusting sword, as if there were a contest between the many feeble and the one strong. He strives in vain.
7-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the intersection of intellect and victory, where your strategic mind harnesses the power of air and fire to outwit opposition with clarity and precision. The force of Moon in Aquarius, elevated by fiery energy, grants you innovative solutions and courageous adaptability, enabling you to navigate complexities with confident diplomacy and visionary insight.
7-of-swords.illDignified: The force of this card becomes fragmented and deceptive when earth's heavy influence prevails, breeding stagnation and mistrust in your endeavors. You risk becoming ensnared in futile manipulations or self-deception, where vacillation turns to cowardice and your attempts at appeasement lead only to entrapment and loss.

8-of-swords.title: 8 of Swords
meaning:
Jupiter in Gemini — Interference

The number Eight, Hod, here signifies lack of persistence in matters of the intellect and of contest. Good fortune, however, attends even these weakened efforts, thanks to the influence of Jupiter in Gemini, ruling the Decan. Yet the Will is constantly thwarted by accidental interference.

The centre of the card is occupied by two long Swords pointed downward. These are crossed by six small swords, three on each side. They remind one of weapons peculiar to their countries or their cults; we see here the Kriss, the Kukri, the Scramasax, the Dagger, the Machete and the Yataghan.
8-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the crossroads of intellect and spirit, where the force of fire ignites your mental faculties with clarity and purpose. The interference that once hindered your will is transformed into dynamic challenges that sharpen your wit and enhance your strategic insight. In this exalted state, Jupiter in Gemini's benevolence guides your thoughts toward profound wisdom and eloquent expression, empowering you to overcome obstacles with confident agility.
8-of-swords.illDignified: The force of earth weighs heavily upon your mind, grounding the air of intellect into confusion and stagnation. Interference becomes oppressive, breeding doubt and miscommunication that obstruct your will and cloud judgment. You risk becoming ensnared in petty disputes or rigid dogma, where the sharpness of your swords dulls into frustration and impotent conflict.

9-of-swords.title: 9 of Swords
meaning:
Mars in Gemini — Cruelty

Consciousness has fallen into a realm unenlightened by reason. This is the world of the unconscious primitive instincts, of the psychopath, of the fanatic. The celestial ruler is Mars in Gemini, crude rage of hunger operating without restraint; although its form is intellectual, it is the temper of the inquisitor.

The symbol shows nine swords of varying lengths, all striking downwards to a point. They are jagged and rusty. Poison and blood drip from their blades. There is, however, a way of dealing with this card: the way of passive resistance, resignation, the acceptance of martyrdom. Nor is an alien formula that of implacable revenge.
9-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of transformative courage, where the fierce intellect of Mars in Gemini is tempered by the purifying fire. Here, the swords become instruments of decisive clarity, cutting through illusion and cruelty to reveal truth and justice. This is the energy of righteous anger wielded with wisdom, driving courageous action that uplifts rather than destroys.
9-of-swords.illDignified: The force of the 9 of Swords is twisted into a tormenting frenzy when earth's stubborn weight suppresses its air-born intellect. Rage becomes blind cruelty, and the mind is shackled by fear and despair, breeding paranoia and self-inflicted suffering. You risk descending into the pit of victimhood or merciless vengeance, severed from reason and light.

10-of-swords.title: 10 of Swords
meaning:
Sun in Gemini — Ruin

The number Ten, Malkuth, as always, represents the culmination of the unmitigated energy of the idea. It shows reason run mad, ramshackle riot of soulless mechanism; it represents the logic of lunatics and (for the most part) of philosophers. It is reason divorced from reality.

The card is also ruled by the Sun in Gemini, but the mercurial airy quality of the Sign serves to disperse his rays; this card shows the disruption and disorder of harmonious and stable energy.

The hilts of the Swords occupy the positions of the Sephiroth, but the points One to Five and Seven to Nine touch and shatter the central Sword (six) which represents the Sun, the Heart, the child of Chokmah and Binah. The tenth Sword is also in splinters. It is the ruin of the Intellect, and even of all mental and moral qualities.
10-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the apex of intellectual clarity, where the Sun in Gemini's mercurial light sharpens your mind to unprecedented heights. The energy of fire surrounding this card ignites transformative insight, purging confusion and disorder, and allowing reason to manifest as creative genius and inspired communication. Here, ruin becomes the fertile ground for rebirth and enlightened understanding.
10-of-swords.illDignified: The force of earth surrounding this card drags the soaring intellect into the mire of rigidity and stagnation. The once vibrant Sun in Gemini dims under the weight of material obsession and dull practicality, twisting the card's energy into destructive cynicism and fractured thought. You face ruin not as renewal, but as the collapse of reason into despair and mental paralysis.

princess-of-swords.title: Princess of Swords
meaning:
The Princess of Swords represents the earthy part of Air, the fixation of the volatile. She brings about the materialisation of Idea. She represents the influence of Heaven upon Earth. She represents to some extent the anger of the Gods, and she appears helmed, with serpent-haired Medusa for her crest. She stands in front of a barren altar as if to avenge its profanation, and she stabs downward with her sword. The heaven and the clouds, which are her home, seem angry.

The character of the Princess is stern and revengeful. Her logic is destructive. She is firm and aggressive, with great practical wisdom and subtlety in material things. She shews great cleverness and dexterity in the management of practical affairs, especially where they are of a controversial nature. She is very adroit in the settlement of controversies.
princess-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of intellectual mastery, where the airy force of the Princess of Swords is harmonized by the fiery energy surrounding her. Your mind is sharp and decisive, wielding the sword of truth with clarity and courage. This card in its highest expression grants you the power to manifest ideas into reality with unwavering focus and righteous conviction.
princess-of-swords.illDignified: The force of the Princess of Swords becomes erratic and destructive when bound by the heavy influence of earth, leading to rigid dogmatism and cold calculation devoid of compassion. Your intellect turns harsh and cutting, wielding logic as a weapon to dominate or manipulate rather than to enlighten. Beware the danger of becoming trapped in petty disputes or vindictive actions that sever you from higher insight.

prince-of-swords.title: Prince of Swords
meaning:
Aquarius

This card represents the airy part of Air. This chariot is drawn by winged children, looking and leaping irresponsibly in any direction that takes their fancy; they are not reined, but perfectly Capricious. The chariot consequently is easy enough to move, but quite unable to progress in any definite direction except by accident. This is a perfect picture of the Mind.

The operation of his logical mental processes has reduced the Air, which is his element, to many diverse geometrical patterns, but in these there is no real plan; they are demonstrations of the powers of the Mind without definite purpose. In his right hand is a lifted sword wherewith to create, but in his left hand a sickle, so that what he creates he instantly destroys. A person thus symbolised is purely intellectual. He is full of ideas and designs which tumble over each other. He is a mass of fine ideals unrelated to practical effort. He has all the apparatus of Thought in the highest degree, intensely clever, admirably rational, but unstable of purpose, and in reality indifferent even to his own ideas, as knowing that any one of them is just as good as any other. He reduces everything to unreality by removing its substance and transmuting it to an ideal world of ratiocination which is purely formal and out of relation to any facts, even those upon which it is based.
prince-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of mental clarity and swift intellectual agility. The force of Air harmonizes with Fire, igniting your thoughts into inspired action and decisive communication. Your mind cuts through confusion, creating innovative ideas that drive purposeful progress and radiant insight.
prince-of-swords.illDignified: The force of Air clashes with the stubborn weight of Earth, causing your thoughts to become muddled and your decisions paralyzed by doubt. You risk becoming scattered and indecisive, trapped in endless mental debates that destroy rather than create. Beware the sword that severs your own foundations through overanalysis and fear.

queen-of-swords.title: Queen of Swords
meaning:
Libra

The Queen of Swords represents the watery part of Air, the elasticity of that element, and its power of transmission. She is enthroned upon the clouds. Her helmet is crested by the head of a child, and from it stream sharp rays of light, illuminating her empire of celestial dew. In her right hand, she bears a sword; in her left hand, the newly severed head of a bearded man. She is the clear, conscious perception of Idea, the Liberator of the Mind.

The person symbolised by this card should be intensely perceptive, a keen observer, a subtle interpreter, an intense individualist, swift and accurate at recording ideas; in action confident, in spirit gracious and just. Her movements will be graceful, and her ability in dancing and balancing exceptional. If ill-dignified, these qualities will all be turned to unworthy purposes. She will be cruel, sly, deceitful and unreliable; in this way, very dangerous, on account of the superficial beauty and attractiveness which distinguish her.
queen-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of mental clarity and swift judgment. The Queen of Swords, empowered by the fiery element, channels sharp intellect with passionate insight, cutting through illusion with decisive action. Her mind is a beacon of truth and justice, guiding you to liberate yourself and others through fearless honesty and unwavering integrity.
queen-of-swords.illDignified: The force of the Queen of Swords is clouded and constrained when burdened by the earth element's heaviness. Her once-clear perception becomes brittle and harsh, wielding her sword as a weapon of cruelty or cold detachment. You may find yourself trapped in cynicism and rigid thought, disconnected from compassion and the fluidity required to truly understand the world around you.

knight-of-swords.title: Knight of Swords
meaning:
Gemini

The Knight of Swords represents the fiery part of Air; he is the wind, the storm. He represents the violent power of motion applied to an apparently manageable element. He is a warrior helmed, and for his crest he bears a revolving wing. Mounted upon a maddened steed, he drives down the Heavens, the Spirit of the Tempest. In one hand is a sword, in the other a poniard. He represents the idea of attack.

The moral qualities of a person thus indicated are activity and skill, subtlety and cleverness. He is fierce, delicate and courageous, but altogether the prey of his idea, which comes to him as an inspiration without reflection.
knight-of-swords.wellDignified: You stand at the forefront of intellectual conquest, where the swift winds of air are kindled by the fires of passion and will. The Knight of Swords, empowered by fire, channels his fierce intellect and decisiveness into purposeful action, embodying clarity, courage, and the swift realization of visionary ideas with honorable precision.
knight-of-swords.illDignified: The force of the Knight of Swords is mired and distorted when weighed down by the stubborn earth. His sharp mind becomes reckless and impulsive, driven by frustration and impatience, leading to rash decisions, conflict, and a destructive storm of thought that lacks grounding or practical insight.

ace-of-disks.title: Ace of Disks
meaning:
The Root of Earth

The Ace of Disks pictures the entry of that type of Energy which is called Earth. About this whirling Disk are its six Wings; the entire symbol is not only a glyph of Earth as understood in this New Aeon of Horus, but of the number 6, the number of the Sun. This card is thus an affirmation of the identity of Sol and Terra.
ace-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of material manifestation, where the fertile waters nurture the seed of Earth. The force of stability and abundance is amplified, grounding your intentions into tangible reality with harmonious growth and sustained prosperity.
ace-of-disks.illDignified: The force of Air disrupts the solid foundation of Earth, scattering your energies into restless uncertainty. You face instability and fragmentation, where material pursuits become erratic, and the promise of growth is hindered by mental agitation and lack of focus.

2-of-disks.title: 2 of Disks
meaning:
Jupiter in Capricorn — Change

The number Two, Chokmah, here rules in the suit pertaining to Earth. It shows the type of Energy appropriate to Two, in its most fixed form. According to the doctrine that Change is the support of stability, the card is called Change.

The card represents two Pantacles, one above the other; they are the Chinese symbols of the Yang and Yin duplicated as in the Hsiang. One wheel is dextro- and the other laevo-rotatory. They thus represent the harmonious interplay of the Four Elements in constant movement. One may in fact consider the card as the picture of the complete manifested Universe, in respect of its dynamics.
2-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the pivotal point where change becomes a harmonious dance of growth and stability. The force of Jupiter in Capricorn, when tempered by the fluidity of Water, manifests as a wise and adaptive transformation, fostering abundance through balanced effort and emotional insight.
2-of-disks.illDignified: The force of change is distorted when you are surrounded by the harsh, penetrating air of intellect and detachment. Instead of fluid motion, the energy becomes erratic and unstable, leading to confusion, indecision, and a disruptive restlessness that undermines the natural cycles of growth.

3-of-disks.title: 3 of Disks
meaning:
Mars in Capricorn — Works

The influence of Binah in the sphere of Earth shows the material establishment of the idea of the Universe, the determination of its basic form. It is ruled by Mars in Capricornus; he is exalted in that Sign, and therefore at his best. His energy is constructive, like that of the builder or engineer. The card represents a pyramid viewed from above the apex.

This pyramid is situated in the great Sea of Binah in the Night of Time, but the sea is solidified; hence the colours of the background are mottled, a cold thin dark grey with a pattern of indigo and green. The sides of the pyramid have a strong reddish tint, showing the influence of Mars.
3-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of purposeful endeavor, where Mars in Capricorn's disciplined energy is harmonized by the fluid intuition of Water. The force of Binah's material establishment is refined and nurtured, enabling you to manifest your visions with both strength and emotional wisdom. Here, your work is not only solid and enduring but also deeply connected to the currents of life, bringing forth lasting creative achievements.
3-of-disks.illDignified: The force of Mars in Capricorn becomes rigid and harsh when challenged by the airy instability of hostile elements. You may find your constructive efforts undermined by impatience, inflexibility, or misdirected ambition, resulting in a brittle and fractured foundation. Beware the cold hardness that resists adaptation, for in this state, your labor leads to frustration, conflict, and wasted potential.

4-of-disks.title: 4 of Disks
meaning:
Sun in Capricorn — Power

The Four, Chesed, shows the establishment of the Universe in three dimensions, that is, below the Abyss. The generating idea is exhibited in its full material sense. The card is ruled by the Sun in Capricornus, the Sign in which he is reborn. The disks are very large and solid; the suggestion of the card is that of a fortress. This represents Law and Order, maintained by constant authority and vigilance. The disks themselves are square; revolution is very opposite to the card; and they contain the signs of the Four Elements. For all that, they revolve; defence is valid only when violently active.

So far as it appears stationary, it is the 'dead centre' of the engineer; and Capricornus is the point at which the Sun 'turns again Northward'. The background is of deep azure, flecked yellow, suggesting a moat; but beyond this is a pattern of green and indigo to represent the guarded fields whose security is assured by the fortress.
4-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of material mastery, where the steadfast power of Earth harmonizes with the fluid wisdom of Water. The force of disciplined authority is not rigid but adaptable, nurturing growth and stability through compassionate governance and emotional intelligence. This is the fortress of law imbued with nurturing strength, where order serves the higher good and sustains enduring prosperity.
4-of-disks.illDignified: The force of your steadfast power is undermined by the restless winds of Air, scattering your foundations and corrupting your vigilance. What should be a fortress of law and order becomes a prison of inflexible dogma or oppressive control, tearing itself apart through internal discord and intellectual arrogance. You risk losing the balance of power, becoming trapped in a cycle of conflict and instability.

5-of-disks.title: 5 of Disks
meaning:
Mercury in Taurus — Worry

The Number Five, Geburah, in the suit of Earth, shows the disruption of the Elements, just as in the other suits. This is emphasised by the rule of Mercury in Taurus, types of energy which are opposed. It needs a very powerful Mercury to upset Taurus; so, the natural meaning is Intelligence applied to Labour.

The symbol represents five disks in the form of the inverted Pentagram, instability in the very foundations of Matter. The effect is that of an earthquake. They are, however, representative of the five Tattvas; these hold together, on a very low plane, an organism which would otherwise disrupt completely. The background is an angry, ugly red with yellow markings. The general effect is one of intense strain; yet the symbol implies long-continued inaction.
5-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the crossroads of earthly labor and flowing emotion, where the harmonious influence of Water elevates Mercury in Taurus. The force of your intellect applied with steady patience brings fruitful stability and nurtures growth amidst change. This card reveals your ability to transform worries into practical solutions, grounding your energies into constructive and sustained effort.
5-of-disks.illDignified: The force of Air clashes disruptively with the earthy foundation of this card, fracturing the stability you seek. You face mental agitation and restless anxiety that undermine your labor and scatter your focus. The once steady intelligence becomes erratic worry, breeding confusion and destabilizing your material and emotional security.

6-of-disks.title: 6 of Disks
meaning:
Moon in Taurus — Success

The Number Six, Tiphareth, as before, represents the full harmonious establishment of the Energy of the Element. The Moon in Taurus rules the card; and this, while increasing the approach to perfection (for the Moon is exalted in Taurus and therefore in her highest form) marks that the condition is transient.

The disks are arranged in the form of the Hexagram, which is shown in skeleton. In the centre blushes and glows the light rose- madder of dawn, and without are three concentric circles, golden yellow, salmon-pink, and amber. These colours show Tiphareth fully realised on Earth; it reaffirms in form what was mathematically set forth in describing the Ace. The planets are arranged in accordance with their usual attribution; but they are only shown as disks irradiated by the Sun in their centre. This Sun is idolised as the Rose and Cross; the Rose has forty-nine petals, the interplay of the Seven with the Seven.
6-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of tangible prosperity and harmonious growth, where the nurturing energies of water amplify the fertile earth of this card. The Moon in Taurus shines with exalted brilliance, guiding you toward sustainable success, fruitful collaborations, and the blossoming of enduring material and emotional wealth. This is the full flowering of your efforts, harmoniously balanced and blessed by the tides of intuition and feeling.
6-of-disks.illDignified: The force of air disrupts the grounded stability of the Six of Disks, scattering its energies into restless and unstable patterns. You may find your pursuit of success undermined by over-intellectualization, impatience, or dispersal of focus, turning the once harmonious establishment into fleeting illusions or hollow achievements. Beware the temptation to sacrifice substance for superficial gains, for the exaltation of the Moon in Taurus becomes a fragile mirage under hostile influence.

7-of-disks.title: 7 of Disks
meaning:
Saturn in Taurus — Failure

The number Seven, Netzach, has its customary enfeebling effect, and this is made worse by the influence of Saturn in Taurus. The disks are arranged in the shape of the geomantic figure Rubeus, the ugliest and most menacing of the Sixteen. The atmosphere of the card is that of Blight. On the background, which represents vegetation and cultivation, everything is spoiled. The four colours of Netzach appear, but they are blotched with angry indigo and reddish orange. The disks themselves are the leaden disks of Saturn. They suggest bad money.
7-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of steadfast perseverance and fruitful patience. The force of Saturn in Taurus, harmonized by the nurturing flow of water, grants you the power to transform adversity into lasting stability. This is the mastery of slow cultivation, where apparent failure becomes the fertile soil for eventual, enduring success.
7-of-disks.illDignified: The force of this card, when beset by the swift and disruptive air element, becomes fragmented and chaotic. You face the danger of paralysis through over-analysis, where the rigidity of Saturn in Taurus hardens into stubbornness and the potential for growth is choked by fear and doubt. Here, failure festers into stagnation, and the blight of doubt consumes the fruits of your labor.

8-of-disks.title: 8 of Disks
meaning:
Sun in Virgo — Prudence

The number Eight, Hod, is very helpful in this card, because it represents Mercury in his most spiritual aspect, and he both rules and is exalted in the sign of Virgo, which belongs to the Decan, and is governed by the Sun. It signifies intelligence lovingly applied to material matters, especially those of the agriculturalist, the artificer and the engineer.

One might suggest that this card marks the turn of the tide. The seven of Disks is in one sense the fullest possible establishment of Matter — compare Atu XV — the lowest fallen and therefore the highest exalted. These last three cards seem to prepare the explosion which will renew the whole Cycle. Note that Virgo is Yod, the secret seed of Life, and also the Virgin Earth awaiting the Phallic Plough.

The interest of this card is the interest of the common people. The rulership of the Sun in Virgo suggests also birth. The disks are arranged in the form of the geomantic figure Populus. These disks may be represented as the flowers or fruits of a great tree, its solid roots in fertile land.
8-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the crossroads of practical wisdom and spiritual insight, where the fertile waters nurture the seeds of your diligent efforts. The force of this card, strengthened by the element of water, reveals the harmonious integration of intellect and emotion, allowing you to manifest your labor with patience and heartfelt precision. This is the pinnacle of prudence, where your careful planning yields abundant and lasting growth.
8-of-disks.illDignified: The force of earth, when beset by the errant winds of air, becomes scattered and unfocused, your prudent intentions lost amid restless thoughts and distractions. You face the challenge of impatience and over-intellectualization, where the careful structure you sought to build is undermined by doubt and inconsistency. Beware the erosion of your grounded efforts by capricious ideas that sap your strength and cloud your vision.

9-of-disks.title: 9 of Disks
meaning:
Venus in Virgo — Gain

The number Nine, Yesod, inevitably brings back the balance of Force in fulfilment. The card is ruled by Venus in Virgo. It shows good luck attending material affairs, favour and popularity.

The disks are arranged as an equilateral triangle of three, apex upwards, close together; and, surrounded at some distance by a ring, six larger disks in the form of a hexagon. This signifies the multiplication of the original established Word-by the mingling of 'good luck and good management'. The three central disks are of the magical pattern as in earlier cards; but the others, since the descent into matter implies the gradual exhaustion of the original whirling energy, now take on the form of coins. These may be marked with the magical images of the appropriate planets.
9-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of material mastery, where the fertile waters of emotion nourish the earth's bounty. The force of Venus in Virgo, harmonized with the receptive flow of Water, manifests as abundant prosperity born from careful stewardship and heartfelt intention. Your efforts are not only fruitful but also imbued with grace and genuine fulfillment.
9-of-disks.illDignified: The force of Venus in Virgo falters when buffeted by the restless winds of Air, distorting your gains into fleeting illusions or hollow achievements. You may find that careless chatter, fickle thoughts, or superficial intellect undermine the solidity of your material foundation, leading to instability and squandered potential. Beware the erosion of substance by empty words and ungrounded plans.

10-of-disks.title: 10 of Disks
meaning:
Mercury in Virgo — Wealth

Mercury rules this card in Virgo; and this may imply that the acquired wealth, being inert, will be dissipated unless put to further use by devoting its power to objects other than mere accumulation. The disks, or (as they have now become) coins, are arranged on the Tree of Life, but the Tenth coin is much larger than the rest; the image indicates the futility of material gain.

These disks are inscribed with various symbols of mercurial character except that the coin in the place of Hod (Mercury) on the Tree is marked with the cipher of the Sun.
10-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the threshold of manifest prosperity when the nurturing waters of emotion and intuition surround this card. The force of Mercury in Virgo channels practical wisdom and diligent care, transforming wealth into a sustaining resource that supports growth, healing, and the enrichment of life beyond mere possession. Here, your material gains become the fertile ground for spiritual and communal flourishing.
10-of-disks.illDignified: The force of conflicting intellect and detachment, represented by air, distorts the grounded energy of this card, scattering the seeds of wealth into aimless dispersal. You risk becoming ensnared in the illusion of accumulation without purpose, where material gains serve only as a hollow measure of success, disconnected from deeper meaning or constructive use. Beware the futility of wealth that lacks conscious direction and heart.

princess-of-disks.title: Princess of Disks
meaning:
The Princess of Disks represents the earthy part of Earth. She is consequently on the brink of transfiguration. She is strong and beautiful, with an expression of intense brooding, as if about to become aware of secret wonder.

Her crest is the head of the ram, and her sceptre descends into the earth. There its head becomes a diamond, the precious stone of Kether, thus symbolising the birth of the highest and purest light in the deepest and darkest of the Elements. She stands within a grove of sacred trees before an altar suggesting a wheatsheaf, for she is a priestess of Demeter. She bears within her body the secret of the future. Her sublimity is further emphasised by the disk which she bears; for in the centre thereof is the Chinese ideogram denoting the twin spiral force of Creation in perfect equilibrium; from this is born the rose of Isis, the great fertile Mother.
princess-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the fertile threshold of manifestation, where the nurturing forces of Earth harmonize with the flowing currents of Water. The Princess of Disks, well dignified, embodies fertile creativity, grounded intuition, and the blossoming of potential into tangible form. You are empowered to cultivate your visions with patience and grace, drawing from deep emotional wells to bring forth lasting abundance.
princess-of-disks.illDignified: The force of Earth confronted by Air’s restless breath leaves you unsteady, as the Princess of Disks' steady growth is disrupted by scattered thoughts and fragmented intentions. Ill dignified, this card warns of stagnation masked by superficial busyness, where practical endeavors falter under doubt and lack of focus. Beware illusions of progress that conceal inner barrenness and thwart true development.

prince-of-disks.title: Prince of Disks
meaning:
Taurus

The Prince of Disks represents the airy part of Earth, indicating the florescence and fructification of that element. The figure of this Prince is meditative. He is the element of Earth become intelligible. In his left hand he holds his disk, which is an orb resembling a globe, marked with mathematical symbols as if to imply the planning involved in agriculture. In his right hand he bears an orbed sceptre surmounted by a cross, a symbol of the Great Work accomplished.

A steadfast and per severing worker, he is competent, ingenious, thoughtful, cautious, trustworthy, imperturbable. He constantly seeks new uses for common things, and adapts his circumstances to his purposes in a slow, steady, well-thought-out plan. He is lacking almost entirely in emotion. He is somewhat insensitive, and may appear dull, but he is not; it so appears because he makes no effort to understand ideas which are beyond his scope. He may often appear stupid, and is inclined to be resentful of more spiritual types. He is slow to anger, but, if driven, becomes implacable.
prince-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the pinnacle of earthly mastery, where the fertile waters nurture your steadfast endeavors. The Prince of Disks, harmonized with the element of water, manifests as a wise and nurturing cultivator of material resources, blending intuition with practical skill. Your projects flourish with patience and care, yielding abundant and sustainable growth.
prince-of-disks.illDignified: The force of disruptive air challenges your grounded nature, scattering your careful plans like leaves in a storm. When ill-dignified by air, the Prince of Disks becomes rigid and obstinate, losing touch with reality through over-intellectualization or inflexibility. You risk stagnation or misapplication of your talents, resulting in frustration and wasted effort.

queen-of-disks.title: Queen of Disks
meaning:
Capricorn

The Queen of Disks represents the watery part of Earth, the function of that element as Mother. She represents passivity, usually in its highest aspect. The Queen of Disks is throned upon the life of vegetation. She contemplates the background, where a calm river winds through a sandy desert to bring to it fertility. Oases are beginning to shew themselves amid the wastes. Before her stands a goat upon a sphere. There is here a reference to the dogma that the Great Work is fertility. She thus represents the ambition of matter to take part in the great work of Creation.

Persons signified by this card possess the finest of the quieter qualities. They are ambitious, but only in useful directions. They possess immense funds of affection, kindness, and greatness of heart. They are not intellectual, and not particularly intelligent; but instinct and intuition are more than adequate for their needs. These people are quiet, hard-working, practical, sensible, domesticated, often (in a reticent and unassuming fashion) lustful and even debauched. They are inclined to the abuse of alcohol and of drugs. It is as if they could only realise their essential happiness by getting outside themselves.
queen-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the serene heart of earthly nurture, where the Queen of Disks' energy flourishes in harmony with the water element. Her capacity for compassionate stewardship and fertile creativity is magnified, enabling you to manifest abundance, stability, and growth with grace and wisdom. This is the embodiment of nurturing power that supports life’s unfolding cycles in their highest form.
queen-of-disks.illDignified: The force of the Queen of Disks is disrupted by the harsh winds of air, scattering her fertile energies into confusion and instability. You may find yourself overwhelmed by restlessness, detachment, or misguided ambition that undermines the natural flow of growth and nurturance. Beware the cold logic that fractures warmth and the sterile intellect that suffocates the vital root of life.

knight-of-disks.title: Knight of Disks
meaning:
Virgo

The Knight of Disks represents the fiery part of Earth, and refers in particular to the phenomena of mountains, earthquakes, and gravitation; but it also represents the activity of Earth regarded as the producer of Life. This warrior is short and sturdy in type. He rides through the fertile land; even the distant hills are cultivated fields.

Those whom he symbolises tend to be dull, heavy and pre-occupied with material things. They are laborious and patient, but would have little intellectual grasp even of matters which concern them most closely. Their success in these is due to instinct, to imitation of Nature. They lack initiative; their fire is the smouldering fire of the process of growth.
knight-of-disks.wellDignified: You stand at the fertile crossroads of Earth and Water, where the Knight of Disks' energy is harmoniously amplified. Here, his laborious patience is transformed into steady, nurturing growth, manifesting as practical wisdom and fruitful perseverance that cultivates both land and spirit with unwavering dedication.
knight-of-disks.illDignified: The force of hostile Air disturbs the Knight of Disks, scattering his grounded energies into restless anxiety and scattered efforts. His steadfast nature becomes stubborn rigidity or dull inertia, leading you into lethargy, obstinance, and a loss of productive momentum that stifles growth and material success.
